verses.1: And Moses ascended from Moab to Mount Nebo, which is located on the slopes of Jericho. There, Jehovah saw all the land, including Gilgal and Dan.
verses.2: And all of Naphtali, and the land of Efrayim and Manasyeh, and all of the land of Judah, all the way to the other side of the sea.
verses.3: And the neck and the shoulders were cut off at the base of the spine, in the city of Tamarim, all the way to the ends.
verses.4: And the LORD said to him, “This is the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. It shall be your inheritance. You shall see it with your own eyes; do not cross over.”
verses.5: And Moses, the servant of Jehovah, died there in the land of Moab, as a result of Jehovah’s will.
verses.6: And he buried him in the land of Moab, opposite the house of Pihoer. No one knew of his burial until today.
verses.7: And Moses, who was one hundred and twenty years old at the time of his death, did not close his eyes, nor could he be awakened.
verses.8: And the children of Israel bowed down to Moses in the evening, for thirty days. And those days of mourning for Moses continued.
verses.9: And Joshua, son of Nun, was filled with wisdom. It was as if Moses had placed his hands on him, and the children of Israel listened to him. They did what Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.10: And no prophet has ever arisen in Israel like Moses, whose face was known by God from afar.
verses.11: To all those things and commands that Jehovah commanded to be done in the land of Egypt, for Pharaoh and all his servants, and for all the land.
verses.12: And with all his strong hands, and with all his great power, Moses performed those miracles before all the Israelites.
